mapper.sql: item.id AS ticket_id, item.order_id, orders.user_id, item.passenger_id, passenger.name AS passenger_name, item.run_id, run.train_id, train.train_no, item.from_station_id, item.to_station_id, item.from_seq, item.to_seq, item.seat_type_id, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, item.seat_id, coach.coach_no, seat.seat_no, item.price, item.status, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AS arrival_date_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_item item JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = item.order_id JOIN passenger ON passenger.id = item.passenger_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train ON train.id = run.train_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND to_stop.stop_seq = item.to_seq JOIN seat_type ON seat_type.id = item.seat_type_id LEFT JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.id = item.seat_id LEFT JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.id = seat.coach_id WHERE item.id = #{ticketId} AND orders.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change_record WHERE old_order_item_id = #{oldTicketId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change_record WHERE old_order_item_id = #{oldTicketId} AND status IN ('WAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'WAITING_PAYMENT') AND expire_at > NOW()

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item item JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = item.order_id JOIN train_run run ON run.id = item.run_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND from_stop.stop_seq = item.from_seq JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = run.train_id AND to_stop.stop_seq = item.to_seq WHERE orders.user_id = #{userId} AND item.passenger_id = #{passengerId} AND item.id <> #{excludedTicketId} AND item.status IN ('LOCKED', 'ISSUED', 'CHANGE_LOCKED') AND (orders.status <> 'PENDING_PAYMENT' OR orders.expire_at > NOW()) AND #{departureDateTime} < TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AND #{arrivalDateTime} > TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time)

SELECT candidate.run_id, candidate.train_no, candidate.train_type, candidate.from_station_id, candidate.from_station_name, candidate.to_station_id, candidate.to_station_name, candidate.departure_date_time, candidate.arrival_date_time, seat_type.code AS seat_type_code, seat_type.name AS seat_type_name, fare.price, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM train_seat seat JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.id = seat.coach_id WHERE coach.train_id = candidate.train_id AND coach.seat_type_id = seat_type.id AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_segment_inventory inventory WHERE inventory.seat_id = seat.id AND inventory.run_id = candidate.run_id AND inventory.segment_seq >= candidate.from_seq AND inventory.segment_seq < candidate.to_seq AND inventory.status = 'AVAILABLE') = candidate.to_seq - candidate.from_seq) AS available_count FROM ( SELECT new_run.id AS run_id, new_run.train_id, train.train_no, train.train_type, old_item.from_station_id, from_station.name AS from_station_name, old_item.to_station_id, to_station.name AS to_station_name, from_stop.stop_seq AS from_seq, to_stop.stop_seq AS to_seq, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(new_run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) AS departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(new_run.run_date, INTERVAL to_stop.arrival_day_offset DAY), to_stop.arrival_time) AS arrival_date_time FROM order_item old_item JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = old_item.order_id AND orders.user_id = #{userId} JOIN station from_station ON from_station.id = old_item.from_station_id JOIN station to_station ON to_station.id = old_item.to_station_id JOIN train_stop from_stop ON from_stop.station_id = old_item.from_station_id JOIN train_stop to_stop ON to_stop.train_id = from_stop.train_id AND to_stop.station_id = old_item.to_station_id AND to_stop.stop_seq > from_stop.stop_seq JOIN train_run new_run ON new_run.train_id = from_stop.train_id AND new_run.run_date = #{travelDate} AND new_run.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND new_run.inventory_initialized = 1 JOIN train ON train.id = new_run.train_id AND train.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE old_item.id = #{ticketId} AND old_item.status = 'ISSUED' AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(new_run.run_date, INTERVAL from_stop.departure_day_offset DAY), from_stop.departure_time) > NOW() ) candidate JOIN train_fare fare ON fare.train_id = candidate.train_id AND fare.from_seq = candidate.from_seq AND fare.to_seq = candidate.to_seq JOIN seat_type ON seat_type.id = fare.seat_type_id ORDER BY candidate.departure_date_time, seat_type.sort_no

SELECT change_record.id AS change_id, change_record.change_no, change_record.status, old_item.id AS old_ticket_id, new_item.id AS new_ticket_id, old_item.passenger_id, passenger.name AS passenger_name, old_item.run_id AS old_run_id, old_train.train_no AS old_train_no, old_type.code AS old_seat_type_code, old_coach.coach_no AS old_coach_no, old_seat.seat_no AS old_seat_no, new_item.run_id AS new_run_id, new_train.train_no AS new_train_no, new_type.code AS new_seat_type_code, new_coach.coach_no AS new_coach_no, new_seat.seat_no AS new_seat_no, new_item.from_station_id, from_station.name AS from_station_name, new_item.to_station_id, to_station.name AS to_station_name, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(new_run.run_date, INTERVAL new_from.departure_day_offset DAY), new_from.departure_time) AS new_departure_date_time, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(new_run.run_date, INTERVAL new_to.arrival_day_offset DAY), new_to.arrival_time) AS new_arrival_date_time, change_record.original_amount, change_record.new_amount, change_record.difference_amount, change_record.difference_type, change_record.expire_at, change_record.confirmed_at, change_record.cancelled_at, change_record.created_at FROM change_record change_record JOIN order_item old_item ON old_item.id = change_record.old_order_item_id JOIN order_item new_item ON new_item.id = change_record.new_order_item_id JOIN passenger ON passenger.id = old_item.passenger_id JOIN train_run old_run ON old_run.id = old_item.run_id JOIN train old_train ON old_train.id = old_run.train_id JOIN seat_type old_type ON old_type.id = old_item.seat_type_id LEFT JOIN train_seat old_seat ON old_seat.id = old_item.seat_id LEFT JOIN train_coach old_coach ON old_coach.id = old_seat.coach_id JOIN train_run new_run ON new_run.id = new_item.run_id JOIN train new_train ON new_train.id = new_run.train_id JOIN seat_type new_type ON new_type.id = new_item.seat_type_id LEFT JOIN train_seat new_seat ON new_seat.id = new_item.seat_id LEFT JOIN train_coach new_coach ON new_coach.id = new_seat.coach_id JOIN station from_station ON from_station.id = new_item.from_station_id JOIN station to_station ON to_station.id = new_item.to_station_id JOIN train_stop new_from ON new_from.train_id = new_run.train_id AND new_from.stop_seq = new_item.from_seq JOIN train_stop new_to ON new_to.train_id = new_run.train_id AND new_to.stop_seq = new_item.to_seq WHERE change_record.id = #{changeId} AND change_record.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE change_record SET status = #{newStatus}, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} IN ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN NOW() ELSE cancelled_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{changeId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
